    function proofRecords(kind, id, version, published) {
      return get(published ? /databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(version)/$(kind)/$(id) : /databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(version)/$(kind)/$(id)).data.records;
    }

    function payloadHeader(p) {
      return p is map && p.keys().hasOnly(['version', 'changes']) && p.version == 1
        && p.changes is map && p.changes.keys().hasOnly(["products","categories","types","worlds","guides","blocks","pages"])
        && known_products(p.changes.get("products", {}))
        && known_categories(p.changes.get("categories", {}))
        && known_types(p.changes.get("types", {}))
        && known_worlds(p.changes.get("worlds", {}))
        && known_guides(p.changes.get("guides", {}))
        && known_blocks(p.changes.get("blocks", {}))
        && known_pages(p.changes.get("pages", {}));
    }

    }
    function draftEnvelope() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasOnly(['payload', 'revision', 'draftId', 'updatedAt', 'updatedBy'])
        && d.revision is int && d.updatedBy == request.auth.uid && d.updatedAt == request.time
        && uuid(d.draftId) && payloadHeader(d.payload)
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/root-proof-0).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftContent/$(request.auth.uid)/versions/$(d.draftId)/proofs/root-proof-1).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {}), "categories": d.payload.changes.get("categories", {}), "types": d.payload.changes.get("types", {}), "worlds": d.payload.changes.get("worlds", {}), "guides": d.payload.changes.get("guides", {}), "blocks": d.payload.changes.get("blocks", {}), "pages": d.payload.changes.get("pages", {})};
    }
    function publicEnvelope() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      let release = getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(d.revisionId)).data;
      return d.keys().hasOnly(['payload', 'revision', 'revisionId', 'updatedAt'])
        && d.revision is int && uuid(d.revisionId) && d.updatedAt == request.time
        && payloadHeader(d.payload) && release.revision == d.revision
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/root-proof-0).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {})}
        && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/publishedContent/$(d.revisionId)/proofs/root-proof-1).data.records == {"products": d.payload.changes.get("products", {}), "categories": d.payload.changes.get("categories", {}), "types": d.payload.changes.get("types", {}), "worlds": d.payload.changes.get("worlds", {}), "guides": d.payload.changes.get("guides", {}), "blocks": d.payload.changes.get("blocks", {}), "pages": d.payload.changes.get("pages", {})};
    }
    function proofData(proof, records, version, published) {
      return (proof == "products-proof-0" && proof_products_proof_0(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-1" && proof_products_proof_1(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-2" && proof_products_proof_2(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-3" && proof_products_proof_3(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-4" && proof_products_proof_4(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-5" && proof_products_proof_5(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-6" && proof_products_proof_6(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-7" && proof_products_proof_7(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-8" && proof_products_proof_8(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-9" && proof_products_proof_9(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-10" && proof_products_proof_10(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-11" && proof_products_proof_11(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-12" && proof_products_proof_12(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "products-proof-13" && proof_products_proof_13(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "other-proof-0" && proof_other_proof_0(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "root-proof-0" && proof_root_proof_0(records, version, published))
        || (proof == "root-proof-1" && proof_root_proof_1(records, version, published));
    }
    function imageData() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.bytes is bytes && d.bytes.size() > 0 && d.bytes.size() <= 196608
        && d.mime == 'image/webp' && d.createdAt == request.time;
    }
    match /admins/{uid} {
      allow get: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow list, write: if false;
    }
    match /cms/draft {
      allow read: if owner();
      allow create: if owner() && draftEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == 1;
      allow update: if owner() && draftEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == resource.data.revision + 1;
      allow delete: if false;
    }
    match /draftContent/{uid}/versions/{version}/groups/{group} {
      allow read: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow create: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid && uuid(version)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && groupData(group, request.resource.data.records, false);
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /draftContent/{uid}/versions/{version}/proofs/{proof} {
      allow read: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow create: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid && uuid(version)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && proofData(proof, request.resource.data.records, version, false);
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /publishedContent/{release}/proofs/{proof} {
      allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(release)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && proofData(proof, request.resource.data.records, release, true)
        && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /publishedContent/{release}/groups/{group} {
      allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(release)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['records', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && groupData(group, request.resource.data.records, true)
        && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /public/site {
      allow read: if true;
      allow create: if owner() && publicEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == 1;
      allow update: if owner() && publicEnvelope() && request.resource.data.revision == resource.data.revision + 1;
      allow delete: if false;
    }
    match /revisions/{id} {
      allow read: if owner();
      allow create: if owner()
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['payload', 'revision', 'createdAt', 'kind'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && ((id == 'initial' && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site)
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revision == 1
          && request.resource.data.revision == 0 && request.resource.data.kind == 'initial'
          && request.resource.data.payload == {'version': 1, 'changes': {}})
        || (uuid(id) && request.resource.data.kind in ['publish', 'restore']
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revisionId == id
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revision == request.resource.data.revision
          && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.payload == request.resource.data.payload));
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /mediaReleases/{id} {
      allow read: if owner();
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(id)
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['revision', 'createdAt'])
        && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revisionId == id
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.revision == request.resource.data.revision
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/revisions/$(id)).data.revision == request.resource.data.revision
        && getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/revisions/$(id)).data.payload == getAfter(/databases/$(database)/documents/public/site).data.payload;
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /draftImages/{uid}/images/{id} {
      allow read: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow create: if owner() && request.auth.uid == uid && uuid(id) && imageData()
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['bytes', 'mime', 'createdAt']);
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /publishedImages/{release}/images/{id} {
      allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release));
      allow create: if owner() && uuid(release) && uuid(id) && imageData()
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['bytes', 'mime', 'sourceId', 'createdAt'])
        && uuid(request.resource.data.sourceId)
        && !exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/mediaReleases/$(release))
        && request.resource.data.bytes == get(/databases/$(database)/documents/draftImages/$(request.auth.uid)/images/$(request.resource.data.sourceId)).data.bytes;
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if false; }
  }
}
